data.name: Ui_OpenFileTip
data.value: Shows a ZPL file from disk as if it had been printed to LabelScope

data.name: Ui_PasteZplTip
data.value: Shows the ZPL that is on the clipboard

data.name: Ui_CopyZplTip
data.value: Copies the ZPL of the selected label

data.name: Ui_ClearJobsTip
data.value: Removes every job from the list. Printer memory is kept.

data.name: Ui_FitTip
data.value: Fits the whole label in the window

data.name: Ui_SizePickerTip
data.value: The label loaded in the printer, used when the ZPL gives no size. Choosing another one saves it and draws every job again.

data.name: Ui_InstallPrinterTip
data.value: Adds the Windows printer that sends labels to LabelScope

data.name: Ui_CopyOriginalTip
data.value: Copies the ZPL exactly as it was received

data.name: Ui_ClearMemoryTip
data.value: Deletes the graphics and fonts that LabelScope keeps from ~DG, ~DY and ^IS downloads, and the font letters set with ^CW

data.name: Ui_StatusNoPrinter
data.value: Listening, but the Windows printer “{0}” is not installed. Choose Printer setup to install it.

data.name: Ui_StatusNameTaken
data.value: Listening, but another Windows printer already uses the name “{0}”. Choose Printer setup and pick another name.

data.name: Ui_StatusPrinterUnknown
data.value: Listening on {0}. The Windows printer could not be checked.

data.name: Ui_StatusPrinterSettings
data.value: Listening on {0}. The printer settings need fixing; see the message at the bottom.

data.name: Ui_StatusNotListening
data.value: Not listening — labels cannot arrive. See the message at the bottom for what to do.

data.name: Ui_SelectedNone
data.value: Selected: nothing. Click a field on the label, a row in Fields or a ZPL line.

data.name: Ui_EmptyCanvas
data.value: No label yet. Print to the Windows printer “{0}”, open a ZPL file or paste ZPL.

data.name: Ui_FileTooLarge
data.value: This file is larger than 16 MB, more than a label job can be. Choose a smaller file.

data.name: Ui_FileReadFailed
data.value: The file could not be read. Check that it still exists and that no other program has it open, then try again. Details are in the log file.

data.name: Ui_FileEmpty
data.value: This file holds no ZPL (no ^XA found). Choose a ZPL file.

data.name: Ui_PasteEmpty
data.value: The clipboard holds no ZPL (no ^XA found). Copy the label text first, then press Paste ZPL.

data.name: Ui_PasteFailed
data.value: The clipboard could not be read because another program is using it. Try again.

data.name: Ui_FieldsNoLabel
data.value: No label was drawn from this job, so there are no fields. The Log tab says why.

data.name: Ui_NoJobSelected
data.value: Select a job on the left to see its fields and what happened with it.

data.name: Ui_SizeTip
data.value: Width: {0}. Height: {1}. Drawn at {2} dpi; {3} copy/copies requested.

data.name: Ui_SizeFromZpl
data.value: {0} dots, sent by the program with {1}

data.name: Ui_SizeFromSetup
data.value: {0} dots, the label loaded in Printer setup (the ZPL gives no {1})

data.name: Ui_StartupFailed
data.value: LabelScope could not finish starting. Close it and start it again; details are in the log file.

data.name: Ui_LogFolderFailed
data.value: LabelScope could not create its log folder ({0}). It keeps working without a log file; choose another LogFolder in settings.json to get one.

data.name: Ui_ListenAllNote
data.value: LabelScope accepts labels from other computers on your network (ListenAddress 0.0.0.0). Windows may ask you to allow LabelScope through the firewall; answering that needs an administrator.

data.name: Ui_LabelFailed
data.value: A label arrived but LabelScope could not show it. Send it again; details are in the log file.

data.name: Ui_SkippedLabels
data.value: Skipped showing {0} job(s) because they arrived faster than they can be displayed. They are listed in the log file.

data.name: Ui_NotDrawnNote
data.value: Data arrived but no label picture could be drawn from it. The ZPL and the reasons are shown on the right.

data.name: Ui_IncompleteNote
data.value: A label arrived incomplete (no ^XZ at the end). It is shown as far as it arrived.

data.name: Ui_ShowFailed
data.value: This job could not be shown. Details are in the log file.

data.name: Ui_RerenderFailed
data.value: The jobs could not all be drawn again with the new settings. Details are in the log file; new jobs use the new settings.

data.name: Ui_KeptJobsFailed
data.value: The jobs kept from the last time could not be shown. LabelScope started with an empty list; details are in the log file.

data.name: Ui_LanguageFailed
data.value: The language could not be changed. Details are in the log file.

data.name: Ui_InstallAsk
data.value:
LabelScope will add a Windows printer named “{0}” that sends labels to this program.
Windows will ask for permission once. Continue?

data.name: Ui_PrinterActionFailed
data.value: The printer action did not finish. Details are in the log file; try again.

data.name: Ui_NothingToSave
data.value: There is no label to save yet. Send one to LabelScope, open a ZPL file or paste ZPL first.

data.name: Ui_PngSaveFailed
data.value: The image could not be saved to {0}. Choose another folder and try again.

data.name: Ui_NothingToCopyImage
data.value: There is no label to copy yet. Send one to LabelScope first.

data.name: Ui_ImageCopied
data.value: The label image was copied. Paste it into any program.

data.name: Ui_ClipboardBusy
data.value: LabelScope could not use the clipboard because another program is using it. Try again.

data.name: Ui_NothingToCopyZpl
data.value: There is no ZPL to copy yet. Send a label to LabelScope first.

data.name: Ui_NoZplText
data.value: This job contains no ZPL text to copy.

data.name: Ui_CopyFailed
data.value: The ZPL could not be copied. Details are in the log file.

data.name: Ui_ClearJobsAsk
data.value:
Remove all {0} jobs from the list?
This only clears the list. Graphics and fonts in printer memory are kept.

data.name: Ui_ClearMemoryAsk
data.value:
Delete everything LabelScope keeps in its printer memory (downloaded graphics and fonts, and font letters set with ^CW)?
Labels that use these graphics, fonts or font letters will show a warning until the download or ^CW is sent again.

data.name: Ui_MemoryTip
data.value: Printer memory: {0}. Graphics and fonts sent with ~DG, ~DY or ^IS, and font letters set with ^CW, are kept here until LabelScope closes or you choose Clear printer memory.

data.name: Ui_OpenPathFailed
data.value: Windows could not open {0}. Open it yourself in File Explorer.

data.name: Ui_UpdateAvailable
data.value: A new version of LabelScope is available ({0}). Choose “Update to {0}” in the toolbar to install it.

data.name: Ui_UpdateCheckFailed
data.value: LabelScope could not check for updates. Check the internet connection and try again; details are in the log file.

data.name: Ui_UpdateAsk
data.value:
Install LabelScope {0} now?
LabelScope will close, update itself and open again. Your settings are kept. Jobs in the list on the left are cleared unless “Keep jobs after closing LabelScope” is on.

data.name: Ui_Installing
data.value: Installing the new version. LabelScope will open again in a moment.

data.name: Ui_InstallerBlocked
data.value: Windows did not allow the installer to start. Download LabelScope-Setup.exe from the GitHub releases page and run it yourself; details are in the log file.

data.name: Ui_DownloadFailed
data.value: The new version could not be downloaded. Check the internet connection and try again.

data.name: Ui_InstallerNotSigned
data.value: The downloaded installer is not signed by the LabelScope publisher, so it was deleted and not run. Download LabelScope again from the GitHub releases page.

data.name: Ui_ClearJobsAskOne
data.value:
Remove the {0} job from the list?
This only clears the list. Graphics and fonts in printer memory are kept.
